subject: POC kickoff & ops checklist — quick priority check
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@lumengrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: LumenGrid POC kickoff and lightweight checklist

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference latencies and cost for your anonymized claims routing workload (10k/day). Success metric: <10% delta vs target perf baseline and a cost estimate within agreed threshold.
- Redwood will provide: a lightweight POC environment, a short ops checklist (attached), and a 30–60 minute ops bootcamp to pair with your infra team.
- LumenGrid will provide: a small representative dataset (anonymized), a test S3/bucket or sample payloads, and an infra contact for network allowlist/VPN.

Action items I captured: 
1) Samir: share the IT contact and confirm whether allowlist or VPN is required (needed for the bootcamp).
2) Samir: confirm whether Aug 12 or Aug 13 works for a 30–60 min kickoff.
3) Priya/Monica: share POC checklist + network diagram (attached) and a mutual action plan link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cPOC-mutual-action-plan

I attached the POC-checklist.xlsx and a simple network-diagram.png. If the dates above are tight, we can shift; want to understand priority so we pick the right ramp.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

— Priya

Can we tentatively push the kickoff by a week? I'll loop in our infra lead (cc'd) and get back with the contact.

— Samir

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Quick priority check + offer to run ops bootcamp

Hi Samir — quick bump on this thread: checking whether the POC is still a priority for LumenGrid this month or if we should revisit timing.

If IT work is the blocker, Monica (cc) can run a short operations bootcamp to walk the infra team through the network checklist and minimize back-and-forth. We can do a hands-on 45–60 minute session to:
- walk the POC checklist
- validate allowlist/VPN requirements from your side
- confirm the sample data pipeline and credentials

Two proposed slots (PT): Aug 18 @ 09:00 or Aug 19 @ 09:00. If those don't work, share a couple windows and we'll accommodate. 

If the POC priority has changed, a quick note is totally fine — we can pause the setup and return when ready.

Thanks,
Priya

Thanks — Aug 19 @ 09:00 PT works for us. IT has asked for clarification on network requirements: do you need a site-to-site VPN or is IP allowlisting sufficient for the short POC? Also, we'll share a contact for certs and allowlist changes this afternoon.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the bootcamp.

— Samir
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@lumengrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: LumenGrid POC kickoff and lightweight checklist

Great — confirmed: Aug 19 @ 09:00 PT.

Short answer on networking: for the initial hands-on bootcamp, IP allowlisting is sufficient if you can open outbound TLS to our test endpoint. We only ask for VPN if your security policy forbids external endpoints entirely. Attached network-diagram.png has the two IP ranges and ports we use. If you can share the infra contact, Monica will send a calendar invite with the session link and a short agenda.

I'll keep the POC-checklist.xlsx as the source of truth; Monica will run through the items during the session. If anything changes on your side, please ping me and we can reschedule.

— Priya
